characterRules.topHanFill: solid bright high-chroma color, no gradient
characterRules.topLatinConstruction: asymmetric hand-cut heavy A and i, legible exact letters, not a tiny caption
characterRules.lowerPayoffContour: heavy dark outline around bright solid fill with restrained baseline bounce

variants.top-han: single-row near-full-width ultra-heavy square Han glyphs; bright solid face, separate hard dark offset shadow
variants.top-latin: short emphasized Ai-like Latin term visibly taller and less regular than Han; exact letter case and shape
variants.lower-lead: compact one-row heavy glyphs; selected numeral or short anchor may be white and 15-30% taller; separate dark hard shadow
variants.lower-payoff: heavy bright-filled dark-outlined glyphs on a separate white rectangular band; small local slant/bounce, not scattered stickers
